hooks.text: 背包内物品摆位直接决定自动战斗强度
hooks.excerpt: In Backpack Battles, you fight with your backpack full of items. It matters what you buy, and especially how you place it! The smarter you place your items, the stronger you will be!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 500余种异形物品可合成药水、神兵与龙伙伴
hooks.excerpt: Items come in different shapes, sizes, prices, and rarities. Combine them into even stronger equipment. Brew a powerful potion, craft a legendary weapon, or hatch a dragon friend! There are over 500 different items to choose from!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 七职业各带五分支形成暴击、毒伤或松鼠流派
hooks.excerpt: Pick one of 7 classes depending on your play style, each of them with 5 subclasses ! Do you want heavy crits or poison damage over time? Or squirrels ?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
